RagShortTexts: Protection, diplomacy and fair shares support Fritigern.
Followers need defined food suppliers and levy limits.

Variants.Content: Protection, negotiation and fair returns sustain recognition. Roman aid matters, but followers need to know who supplies food and limits levies.
Protection, diplomacy and fair shares support Fritigern. Military recognition also rests on rewards and relief; a title needs willing action. Followers need defined food suppliers and levy limits.
